why: The argument-less call for this server. Also records what the sandbox actually granted, which bounds every other call here.

The container mounts corpus read-only at /app/corpus and the server is launched with that as its only allowed root, so every path below must sit inside it. The guessed corpus used '.', which is outside the allowed root and would have been refused.

Pulls the planted bait tokens into the MCP response. That is the 'what came back into context' axis of docs/METHOD.md, and for a local control it makes the negative meaningful: the bait is in hand and still nothing leaves.
Metadata-only read, so the corpus exercises a second code path without a second file body.
